verdict.rationale: Carta documents a dedicated playground environment that is similar to production. Developers create a playground app in the Developer Portal and later promote it to production, and there is also a mock option that needs no genuine credentials and returns static but valid responses. This lets users build and test without touching production data. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, documentation that the MCP/Claude plugins can target the playground, and fuller detail on playground data realism beyond static mock responses.
